name: Stivic
description: Stivic was a colony world of the Garwians located in the Stivic system of the Unknown Regions. Like other Garwian Unity worlds, it was a commerce center for a number of species.
lead_paragraphs: Stivic was a colony world of the Garwians located in the Stivic system of the Unknown Regions. Like other Garwian Unity worlds, it was a commerce center for a number of species.
Of all the Garwian worlds, Stivic was particularly close to Lioaoin space. That made Stivic an easy target for a Lioaoin pirate attack, where a Garwian merchant-hub station was attacked.
